bdhs: Tools and Data for the Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey

Source: R/bdhs-package.R
bdhs-package.Rd

bdhs covers every round of the Bangladesh Demographic and Health Survey (1993-94, 1996-97, 1999-2000, 2004, 2007, 2011, 2014, 2017-18 and 2022) together with the Bangladesh Service Provision Assessments and the 2001 Maternal Health Services and Maternal Mortality Survey.

The package has two halves:

  • Bundled, ready-to-use data. Official estimates for every DHS indicator published for Bangladesh (bdhs_indicators), the indicator definitions (bdhs_indicator_catalog), survey and dataset catalogues (bdhs_surveys, bdhs_datasets), cross-round codebooks (bdhs_codebook), division crosswalks (bdhs_regions) and subnational boundaries (bdhs_boundaries()).

  • Your own microdata, made easy. The DHS Program licenses respondent-level data to registered users only and does not allow it to be redistributed, so it is not shipped with the package. Once you have downloaded it, bdhs_import() registers it in a fast local store, bdhs_read() loads any round and recode in one line, bdhs_harmonize() makes variables comparable across rounds, bdhs_design() builds the correct complex survey design and bdhs_estimate() computes indicators that are validated against the official DHS values.

Getting access to the microdata

Register at https://dhsprogram.com/data/new-user-registration.cfm, request access to the Bangladesh surveys, download the files (Stata format is recommended) and run bdhs_import("path/to/downloads").
